sector-4.html:
Sector 4 is a settled residential sector in Old Gurugram, built mainly as HUDA plots with independent houses and builder floors rather than high-rise towers. The roads residents use most are Old Railway Road and Rezang La Marg, and Gurgaon Railway Station is close by along Old Railway Road. Sector 5, Sector 7, Sector 3A and Sector 9A lie around it, and the Sector 4/7 market serves both neighbourhoods.

What this means for tuition: because most homes are houses or floors, a tutor comes straight to your door rather than through a society gate. A tutor already teaching in Sector 5, 7 or 9A can reach you on local roads without joining NH-48. A tutor from the newer sectors along Sohna Road or the Dwarka Expressway has to cross the city, so ask about travel time before you fix a weekday slot. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-5.html:
Three roads frame Sector 5: Old Railway Road on the west, Sheetla Mata Mandir Road on the east and Rezang La Marg on the north. Inside that frame is an older plotted neighbourhood of independent houses and builder floors, with a few newer apartment buildings, and many families here have lived in Gurgaon for years. Sheetla Colony, Sector 4, Sector 6, Sector 3 and Ashok Vihar sit close by.

There is no metro station on the doorstep, so tutors reach Sector 5 by road, usually by two-wheeler, car or auto. That makes the tutor's starting point more important than usual. Someone based in Sector 4, 7 or Sheetla Colony can often fit a class in straight after school hours; a tutor travelling across town may prefer a fixed, later slot. For senior classes where a specialist may live further away, online sessions for part of the week are a practical mix. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-7.html:
Sector 7 sits in the older, western part of the city, between Sector 4, Sector 5, Sector 6, Sector 9 and Laxman Vihar. Homes are a mix of independent houses, builder floors and some apartments, ranging from small units to four-bedroom floors. Madanpuri Road and Old Railway Road carry most local traffic, and Gurgaon Railway Station is close by.

The nearest Yellow Line station, IFFCO Chowk, is a drive away, so few tutors arrive by metro. In practice, parents in Sector 7 do best with a tutor who lives in the neighbouring sectors of Old Gurugram and travels by two-wheeler or car, which keeps a daily or alternate-day schedule realistic. If the subject needs a specialist who lives in a newer part of Gurugram, consider two home classes a week plus one online. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-9.html:
Sector 9 lies along Basai Road in Old Gurugram and is part of a cluster that includes Sector 9A, Sector 9B, Sector 10, Sector 10A, Basai village, Ravi Nagar and Jyoti Park. It has both standalone houses and apartments, including the Housing Board Colony flats, so a parent here may be in a gated block or on an open plotted street. Gurgaon Railway Station is a drive away via Neki Ram Marg, and Basai Dhankot station is a drive away.

For home tuition, the main point is distance from the metro: the Yellow Line is a drive away, so tutors come by road. A tutor who already lives in the Basai Road cluster can usually take a class after school without a long drive, while one coming from the Golf Course Road or Sohna Road side will spend a good part of the evening in traffic. If you live in a Housing Board block, share the gate-entry routine with the tutor before the first class. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-10.html:
Sector 10 mixes homes with shops and small commercial buildings. Around it are older settlements such as Kadipur village, Vikas Nagar, Krishna Nagar, Shanti Nagar and Ravi Nagar, and the planned Sectors 9, 7 and 11. Housing is mostly independent houses, builder floors and some apartments, usually of one to three bedrooms. Pataudi Road and Old Railway Road are the main routes out, and the busier junctions can be slow at peak times.

For a family choosing a tutor, the practical questions are where the tutor starts and when the class begins. IFFCO Chowk metro is a drive away and Basai Dhankot railway station a short drive, so almost every home tutor comes by road. A tutor from Sector 9, 10A or Kadipur can be flexible with timing. Someone crossing from central Gurugram usually needs a fixed slot planned around the evening rush. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-10a.html:
Sector 10A is a residential sector of Old Gurugram next to Sector 11, with Pataudi Road and NH-48 both close by and Hero Honda Chowk nearby. Homes are mainly independent houses and builder floors, with some apartments, covering a wide range of budgets.

Being near NH-48 cuts both ways for tuition. A tutor from the sectors along the highway or around Hero Honda Chowk can reach 10A fairly directly. On the other hand, the highway and its junctions are heavily used at office hours, so a class that starts right at the evening peak can see a late tutor more often than one timed a little earlier or later. Tutors from the neighbouring older sectors, such as 4, 7, 9 and 12, reach it on local roads. IFFCO Chowk metro is a drive away, so metro access is not a deciding factor here. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-12.html:
Sector 12 is one of the busier parts of Old Gurugram. It borders Sector 13, Sector 14 and Arjun Nagar near the Old Delhi–Gurgaon Road, with Sadar Bazar and the Sector 12 market nearby. Sector 12A, close to the Gurgaon bus stand, lies beside it. Housing is a mix of independent houses, builder floors and apartment buildings, with shops and offices among them.

That central, commercial character shapes tuition timing. Traffic around the markets and the bus stand builds up at rush hour, so a tutor coming from farther away may take longer in the evening than the distance suggests. Parents often find it easier to book a tutor from Sector 13, 14, 12A or Old Gurugram itself, or to choose a slot outside the peak. MG Road metro is a drive away and Gurgaon Railway Station a short drive. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-14.html:
Sector 14 is a planned HUDA sector near the centre of Old Gurugram, and its sub-areas include Old DLF Colony, Anamika Enclave and Patel Nagar. Its HUDA market is one of the older HUDA markets in Gurgaon. Homes are largely independent houses and builder floors on plots, with some apartments. Several major roads meet around it: the Old Delhi–Gurgaon Road, MG Road, NH-48 and Jharsa Road. Sector 15, Sector 13 and Civil Lines are next door.

For home tuition, Sector 14 is one of the easier Old Gurugram sectors to reach. IFFCO Chowk metro on the Yellow Line is close by, and tutors from the older sectors on either side of the Old Delhi–Gurgaon Road can arrive by road without a long trip. The market area gets crowded in the evening, so tell the tutor which gate or lane is quickest. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-15.html:
Sector 15 has two distinct halves. Part 1 is a planned, plotted colony of independent bungalows on wide internal roads. A boundary wall closes it on three sides, which keeps through-traffic out and the streets quiet. Part 2 is bordered by MG Road and NH-48 and is mostly builder floors and independent homes. Around the sector are Sector 14, Sector 29 and the Police Lines area.

This layout suits home tuition. Tutors can reach either part quickly from the highway or MG Road, and IFFCO Chowk metro is close enough for a tutor who commutes by metro. In Part 1, remember that a tutor may need to use a particular entry gate, so share the route before the first class. Because Sector 15 sits between the old city and the newer business areas, tutors from both sides can realistically take classes here. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-17.html:
Sector 17 is a mixed-use sector of homes, shops and small businesses. It is split into pockets such as 17A, 17B and 17C, next to Sukhrali village and a HUDA market for everyday shopping. NH-48 runs along it, and MG Road and the Old Delhi–Gurgaon Road are close. Neighbours include Sector 16, Sector 18 and Friends Colony. IFFCO Chowk metro on the Yellow Line is close by.

For a parent, the pocket you live in affects how easy the tutor's trip is. Homes near the highway side are quick to reach for tutors coming from Udyog Vihar, Cyber City or the IFFCO Chowk area. Homes deeper inside, near Sukhrali, are better served by someone who already knows the lanes, often a tutor from Sector 16, 18 or the older sectors nearby. Give the pocket letter and a landmark when you book. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-21.html:
Sector 21 sits on the Old Delhi–Gurgaon Road, close to Dundahera and the Delhi–Gurugram border. It is a busy, mixed-use area with a large number of residents, where apartments and builder floors stand among shops. It borders Palam Vihar, Sector 18 and Sector 22, and its pockets, such as Pocket E, are how most residents give directions.

Its position near the border is useful when choosing a tutor. Candidates can come from the Gurugram sectors on this side of NH-48 or from the Dwarka side of Delhi; a Dwarka tutor may be closer than one in south Gurugram. Cyber City Rapid Metro station is close by and Bijwasan railway station a short drive. The Old Delhi–Gurgaon Road carries heavy traffic in the evening, so settle on a class time that allows for it rather than cutting it fine. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-22.html:
Sector 22 is in the northern part of the city, near the Old Delhi–Gurgaon Road, and is split into 22A and 22B. Much of it is independent houses and builder floors, and it has its own neighbourhood market. Sector 21, Sector 23, Sector 23A and Palam Vihar are its closest neighbours, with Udyog Vihar a short drive away. NH-48 and the Dwarka Expressway are both a short drive away.

Because 22A and 22B are separate pockets, give a tutor the exact block, not just "Sector 22". The nearest rail options are the Palam Vihar and Bijwasan stations, and the Rapid Metro at Cyber City is a drive away, so tutors mostly come by road. Distances within this cluster of sectors (21, 22, 23, 23A and Palam Vihar) are short, so a tutor based in any of them can usually manage weekday evenings. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-23.html:
Sector 23 is a developed HUDA sector of plots, independent houses and builder floors, including three- and four-bedroom homes. It shares boundaries with Sector 23A, Sector 22 and Palam Vihar. The Old Delhi–Gurgaon Road and Carterpuri Road connect it to the rest of the city, and the Sector 23 HUDA market serves the neighbourhood.

For families, the tuition question here is less about distance and more about which way the tutor is coming from. Palam Vihar Halt railway station is close by. The nearest metro options, the Rapid Metro at Cyber City and IFFCO Chowk on the Yellow Line, are a drive away, so the metro rarely decides the choice. A tutor living in Palam Vihar, Sector 22 or 23A is close enough for classes four or five days a week, while one coming down from central Gurugram suits a two- or three-day plan. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-23a.html:
Sector 23A is a residential sector in the north of Gurugram, next to Sector 23 and close to Palam Vihar, Palam Vihar Extension and Om Vihar. Housing here is varied: builder floors, independent houses, residential plots and some low-rise apartment buildings. Carterpuri Road and the Old Delhi–Gurgaon Road are the main links, and Palam Vihar Halt railway station is a drive away.

Sector 23A is well placed for a tutor who already works in the Palam Vihar–Sector 22–Sector 23 cluster, and parents often find the most flexible timings with someone from these sectors. The Cyber City Rapid Metro station is a drive away, so tutors who rely on the metro still need a road leg at the end. Where a subject needs a specialist from further south, a combination of home and online classes keeps the schedule steady during exam months. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

palam-vihar.html:
Palam Vihar is a planned residential colony in the north-west corner of Gurugram, right against the Delhi border near Dwarka. It was first developed by Ansal API. Today it has independent houses, builder floors and apartment complexes, along with extensions such as Palam Vihar Extension. Sectors 22 and 23 border it on the Gurugram side, and Bijwasan and Kapashera lie across the border. The Dwarka Expressway, the Old Delhi–Gurgaon Road and Carterpuri Road connect it to the rest of the region, and IGI Airport is a drive away.

For home tuition, Palam Vihar draws from two directions. Tutors can come from the neighbouring Gurugram sectors or from Dwarka in Delhi. The nearest metro, Dwarka Sector 21, is a drive away, so metro-commuting tutors still need a short road trip. Palam Vihar is spread out, so name the block and nearest gate when you book. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-38.html:
Sector 38 lies along NH-48 in the south-central part of the city. It is bordered by Sector 39, Sector 40, Sector 31 and Jharsa village, and Rajiv Chowk is close by. Medanta – The Medicity is on CH Bakhtawar Singh Road within the sector, and the neighbourhood is largely behind it. Homes range from small rented units to apartments, builder floors and independent houses.

For tuition, the highway and the hospital both affect travel. The main roads around the hospital and the highway junctions can be busy. A tutor from Sector 39, 40 or Jharsa, who can use internal roads, is often more reliable than one crossing the highway at the evening peak. Millennium City Centre on the Yellow Line is a drive away and IFFCO Chowk a short drive, so metro-commuting tutors will need an auto or cab for the last stretch. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-39.html:
Sector 39 is a mid-budget residential sector in the south-central part of the city, between NH-48 and Sohna Road. Homes are mostly mid-rise apartments, builder floors and independent houses. CH Bakhtawar Singh Road runs along it, with Bakhtawar Chowk at one corner and Medanta – The Medicity across the road. Sectors 31, 32, 38, 40, 44 and 46 surround it.

Office buildings in the sector bring weekday traffic, so evening timing matters more here than in a purely residential sector. Millennium City Centre metro is a drive away. Tutors who rely on the metro still need a road trip, while tutors from Sectors 40, 46 or 31 can use short internal roads. Families on the Sohna Road side can also consider tutors from the sectors off that road. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-40.html:
Sector 40 is a HUDA plotted colony in central Gurugram, where most homes are builder floors and independent houses on 10- and 14-marla plots. It has its own HUDA market for daily needs. Sectors 31, 39, 41 and 45 are next to it, along with Jharsa, Silokhera and the Housing Board Colony. NH-48 is within easy reach, and Millennium City Centre, the Yellow Line terminus, is close by.

That metro distance makes Sector 40 relatively easy for tutors who commute from Delhi or from along the Yellow Line: the last leg is a short auto ride rather than a long drive. On a plotted street the tutor comes straight to the house, so first-class directions are simple. Tutors from Sector 39, 41, 45 or Jharsa are close enough for frequent classes, which suits board-exam years and entrance preparation. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-44.html:
Sector 44 is best known as an institutional area of office buildings, but it has homes too. Kanhai Colony, a residential pocket of builder floors and rented flats, is part of it, and apartments and independent floors sit around it. Fortis Memorial Research Institute stands opposite Millennium City Centre metro station, the Yellow Line terminus, which is close to most of the sector. Golf Course Road, MG Road and Sohna Road are close by, and Sector 45, Sector 52 and Sushant Lok Phase I are its neighbours.

With the metro this close, tutors travelling along the Yellow Line can reach it easily. The office area, however, brings heavy traffic at the start and end of the working day. If your home is in Kanhai or near the office blocks, a class that begins after the evening rush is easier to keep. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.
